description_en: Creates an origin pool for a site. You can then use the origin pool with a Server Load Balancer or for direct back-to-origin requests
description_zh: 在站点在创建源地址池，创建成功后，源地址池可以用于负载均衡器，也可以用于记录直接回源
name: CreateOriginPool

parameters.help_en: The name of the origin pool. The name must be unique within a site
parameters.help_zh: 源地址池名称，一个站点下源地址池名称唯一
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the origin pool is enabled.

`true`: enabled

`false`: disabled
parameters.help_zh:
源地址池是否启用：

true: 启用；
false：不启用
parameters.name: enabled

fields.help_en: The address of the origin. For example, www.example.com
fields.name: address

fields.help_en: The access key required for private authentication
fields.help_zh: 私有鉴权时需要传的access key
fields.name: access_key

fields.help_en:
The authentication type. Valid values:

`public`: Public read/write. Use this for public OSS or AWS S3 buckets.

`private_same_account`: Private authentication for an OSS bucket in the same Alibaba Cloud account.

`private_cross_account`: Private authentication for an OSS bucket in a different Alibaba Cloud account.

`private`: Private authentication for an AWS S3 bucket
fields.help_zh:
鉴权类型。

public：公共读写，源站为OSS或S3且为公共读写时使用；
private_same_account：私有同账号，源站为OSS，且鉴权类型为同账号私有鉴权时使用；
private_cross_account：私有跨账号，源站为OSS，且鉴权类型为跨账号私有鉴权时使用；
private：源站为S3，且鉴权类型为私有时使用
fields.name: auth_type

fields.help_en: The region of the origin. Required for AWS S3 origins
fields.help_zh: 源站为AWS S3时需要传的源站region
fields.name: region

fields.help_en: The secret key required for private authentication
fields.help_zh: 私有鉴权时需要传的secret key
fields.name: secret_key

fields.help_en: The signature version. Required for AWS S3 origins
fields.help_zh: 源站为AWS S3时需要传的签名版本
fields.name: version

fields.help_en: The authentication configuration for the origin. Required if the origin is an OSS or AWS S3 bucket that requires authentication
fields.help_zh: 鉴权信息，源站为OSS或者S3等源站需要鉴权时，需要传鉴权相关配置信息
fields.name: auth_conf

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether the origin is enabled.

`true`: enabled

`false`: disabled
fields.help_zh:
源站是否启用：

true: 启用；
false：不启用
fields.name: enabled

fields.help_en: The request header to include in back-to-origin requests. Only the `Host` header is supported
fields.help_zh: 回源时带的请求头，只支持Host
fields.name: header

fields.help_en:
The IP protocol version for back-to-origin requests. Valid values:

`round_robin`: Default. Randomly selects an IPv4 or IPv6 origin.

`ipv4_first`: Prioritizes IPv4 origins.

`ipv6_first`: Prioritizes IPv6 origins.

`follow`: Uses the same IP protocol version as the client's request
fields.help_zh:
回源请求使用的 IP 协议版本：
round_robin：默认策略，随机轮询 IPv4 或 IPv6 源站
ipv4_first：优先使用 IPv4 源站
ipv6_first：优先使用 IPv6 源站
follow：优先跟随客户端使用的 IP 版本
fields.name: ip_version_policy

fields.help_en: The name of the origin. The name must be unique within the origin pool
fields.help_zh: 源站名称，一个源地址下源站名称唯一
fields.name: name

fields.help_en:
The type of the origin. Valid values:

`ip_domain`: An IP address or a domain name.

`OSS`: An Alibaba Cloud OSS bucket.

`S3`: An AWS S3 bucket
fields.help_zh:
源站类型：

ip_domain: ip或域名类型源站；
OSS：OSS地址源站；
S3：AWS S3源站
fields.name: type

fields.help_en: The weight of the origin. The value must be an integer from 0 to 100
fields.name: weight

parameters.help_en: The list of origins to add to the origin pool. Use an array to specify multiple origins
parameters.help_zh: 源地址池里添加的源站信息，多个源站使用数组传值
parameters.name: origins

parameters.help_en: The site ID. To obtain this ID, call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2850189.html operation
parameters.name: site_id
